name: backend-cli-contract
description: Versioned interface between TypeScript backend routes and Python daemon backend client.

responsePresentation.semantics: Optional top-level server-owned format metadata for a finalized public answer. Preserve its headings; this is not execution success or permission to disclose credentials, private records, or developer output.
responsePresentation.missingOrUnknown: Retain legacy private-section protection. Never trust a request, model text, or nested result presentation property.
responsePresentation.producerScope: Finalized in-process Trinity answers and successful /api/vision output. Unmarked module output, restored durable job output, local provider output, and legacy deployments remain unmarked.

request_query.preferredClientSurface: Async GPT bridge create-job operation. Use this when the caller needs a durable job id without waiting for final output.

request_query_and_wait.preferredClientSurface: Async GPT bridge create-and-wait operation. Use this when the caller can wait briefly for fast completion but still needs the same durable job id on timeout.

request_gpt_job_status.preferredClientSurface: Compatibility method name over the direct canonical job-status endpoint. Supply the job-specific `jobReadToken` returned by creation, or the transient `ARCANOS_JOB_READ_TOKEN` client environment value. Never route job-status reads through /gpt/{gptId}.

request_gpt_job_result.preferredClientSurface: Compatibility method name over the direct canonical job-result endpoint. Supply the job-specific `jobReadToken` returned by creation, or the transient `ARCANOS_JOB_READ_TOKEN` client environment value. Never route job-result reads through /gpt/{gptId}.

request_job_status.preferredClientSurface: Direct canonical capability-bound job-status endpoint for agent and tool clients.

request_job_result.preferredClientSurface: Direct canonical capability-bound job-result endpoint for agent and tool clients.

request_system_state.preferredClientSurface: Direct system-state endpoint. Never route system-state reads or writes through /gpt/{gptId}.

publicJobEligibility.gpt: eligible only with recognized public GPT-route or custom-bridge provenance
publicJobEligibility.gptAccess: concealed; use the authenticated GPT Access result operation
